questions.question: What did Jehu do to the worship of Baal in Israel?
options: Reformed it gently, sparing all of its many priests and prophets
Left it completely untouched and turned a blind eye to it
Promoted it far above the true worship of the LORD God
Destroyed it, killing its prophets and tearing down its temple
questions.answer: Destroyed it, killing its prophets and tearing down its temple
